Title: Service Fabric control plane audit logging in development

Body.Content:
Use this to keep a chronological record of calls that have been made to the Service Fabric management endpoint. Use audit logging to investigate suspicious API requests, collect statistics, or create monitoring alerts for unwanted API calls. 

Learn more about ASF.
